purpose: Registry of radio-link protocol families referenced by taxonomy/labels.json. A taxonomy entry names a protocol id here; it never inlines protocol prose. Keeping the registry separate lets one protocol be corrected once (ERRATA) instead of in N device rows.

evidence_levels.verified: Demodulated / decoded from RFUAV's own IQ in a written empirical verification. The only currently verified row is wifi.80211an (Parrot ANAFI, verificacion-empirica-05: beacon decoded bit-exact, FCS CRC-32 valid on 5 beacons).
evidence_levels.vendor_claim: Taken from manufacturer documentation or the protocol project's own docs. NOT measured against this library. May be wrong for the specific unit captured.
evidence_levels.unknown: Radio ships with a swappable / user-flashable internal RF module and the module actually installed at capture time is not recorded anywhere. Do not guess.

global_caveat.statement: F2 (owner-locked fact, 2026-07-31): every device in the library was operated at its factory-default link setting, and that setting was never logged nor verified on air. Many of these radios can switch protocol family from the menu (e.g. Futaba T16IZ: FASSTest/T-FHSS/S-FHSS; FrSky X9D Plus 2019: ACCST D16 or reflashed ACCESS; EdgeTX radios: any internal or external module). Therefore EVERY per-device link_protocol below except uav.parrot.anafi is a prior, not a measurement, and must not be used as a training label or as evaluation ground truth without re-verification.
global_caveat.consequence: link_protocol is metadata for stratification and for reporting; it is NOT a target variable in v2.0.

protocols.waveform: OFDM, 64-pt FFT, 312.5 kHz subcarrier spacing, 0.8 us CP (4.0 us symbol), 52 occupied subcarriers, BPSK..64QAM
protocols.hopping: none (fixed channel; ch149 = 5745 MHz as captured)
protocols.notes: VERIFIED against RFUAV IQ: 5 beacons decoded bit-exact with valid FCS CRC-32; SSID="ANAFI"; SA/BSSID 90:3a:e6:5a:62:96 (OUI 90:3A:E6 = Parrot SA); vendor IE OUI 90:03:B7 = Parrot; beacon comb 102.399 ms (100 TU); duty cycle 0.77-0.88 %; OBW 16.3-17.5 MHz; carrier FIXED at -5 MHz from the 5750 MHz nominal centre. This row is the evidence that refutes the v1 paper's 'PARROT = FHSS, 18.36 MHz' claim.
